description: Find storefront orders when investigating a payment state or fulfillment state. Returns order summaries only: no customer contact details or payment identifiers are included. To look up a known customer's orders, pass their address as the `customerEmail` filter. Money amounts are integers in the currency's minor units (Stripe convention: 2500 = $25.00 USD, 1999 = ¥1999 JPY), paired with each order's currencyCode. For multi-step Replo work, call skills with name "replo".

fulfillmentStatus.description: Only orders in this shipping state.

updatedSince.description: Only orders changed at or after this time, including a package added or its tracking changed. ISO 8601.

name: find_orders
title: Find orders
